title: Senior Growth Manager (Contract)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Working as a Senior Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.

This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.

This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.

title: Software Engineer - Digital Assets
description:
Optiver is looking for a Senior Digital Assets Software Engineer to join our Digital Assets Tech Team in London. In this role, you’ll build and evolve trading systems for cryptocurrency markets, working closely with traders and researchers to deliver solutions in a fast-moving and constantly changing environment.

You’ll play a key role in building out our digital assets platform, helping shape both the technology and engineering practices from the ground up. You’ll work side-by-side with traders and researchers, iterating quickly on ideas and translating market insights into production systems. From integrating with major centralised exchanges to improving system reliability in real-world conditions, your work will directly impact how we trade in this rapidly growing space.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build trading systems for digital asset markets
  • Develop and manage connectivity to centralised exchanges such as Binance, Deribit, and OKX
  • Work directly with traders and researchers to prototype and iterate on trading strategies
  • Improve system reliability through automation, monitoring, and robust recovery mechanisms
  • Troubleshoot issues across trading systems and exchange integrations
  • Contribute to architecture and help shape the digital assets platform
  • Take ownership of production systems and drive continuous improvements

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, ideally in trading, crypto, or other real-time systems
  • Strong C++ development skills, with experience building reliable production systems
  • Hands-on experience integrating with centralised cryptocurrency exchanges (e.g., Binance, Deribit, OKX)
  • Experience working with cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, GCP, or similar) is a plus

title: Software Engineer - Build Platform
description:
At Optiver, the velocity of our software development is a critical part of our competitive advantage. Our ability to compete depends on how quickly new ideas can move from insight to production. The Developer Experience team is a strategic engineering function with a clear mandate: improve the development lifecycle across the company in ways that accelerate delivery and reduce our time to market. We build the tools, systems, and platforms that shape how software is developed at Optiver.

 

The Build Platform sits at the heart of that lifecycle. Every change an engineer makes flows through it. When builds are fast, correct, and reproducible, engineers stay in flow, receive fast and trustworthy feedback, and shipping changes becomes routine. When builds are slow or unreliable, every team in the company pays the tax, one slow feedback loop at a time.

 

We’re looking for a strong engineer with a passion for improving developer productivity, a deep interest in build systems, and the experience to design and operate platforms at scale. You’ll join a growing global Developer Experience team and help shape the future of how software is built, tested, and delivered at Optiver, enabling both engineers and agents to move from idea to production-ready software with greater speed and confidence.

 

What you’ll do

 

  • Shape the future of C++ builds at Optiver by designing and rolling out modern build systems that accelerate build times, improve reliability, and create a more consistent developer experience;
  • Develop common build libraries, reusable CI/CD pipelines, and container images used across the company;
  • Build observability into our platform so we can measure performance, reliability and adoption, and use that data to guide further improvements;
